subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Long Con vs. the Short Con
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Long Con vs. the Short Con.

hook.text: A short con takes five minutes. A long con takes five years. Both follow the same playbook.

buildup.text: Short cons are quick street hustles — the shell game, the pigeon drop, the quick-change scam.

discovery.text: Long cons build relationships over months or years, extracting far larger sums.

twist.text: Long con artists often become genuine friends with their victims, making the betrayal devastating.

climax.text: The scale changes, but the formula stays identical: trust, convincer, sting, blow-off.

punchline.text: Time is the only difference between a hustle and a heist.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between a short con and a long con?
options: Long cons build trust over months or years for larger payoffs
Short cons are always illegal while long cons are legal
